Glance 2026.07.23 is the first public release of Glance, a fast Windows file preview application operated primarily with the Space key.

## Highlights

- Preview files from File Explorer, the Windows desktop, common file dialogs, and Everything.
- View text, code, Markdown, images, audio, video, PDF, archives, folders, and supported Microsoft Office documents.
- Keep previews pinned, open independent preview windows, and remember window size or position by content type.
- Recover automatically when the input Core or preview App exits or becomes unresponsive.
- Configure appearance, text rendering, footer metadata, media behavior, window behavior, diagnostics, and startup behavior.

## Downloads

- `Glance-Setup-2026.07.23-x64.exe`: recommended installer.
- `Glance-2026.07.23-x64.zip`: portable self-contained build.
- `Glance-2026.07.23-x64-symbols.zip`: debugging symbols.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for all release assets.

## Requirements and compatibility

- Windows 11 x64 is the supported platform.
- Compatibility components for file dialogs hosted by 32-bit applications are included.
- Some preview formats require the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
- Office preview requires the corresponding locally installed Microsoft Word, Excel, or PowerPoint application.
- `ffprobe.exe` is optional and is not bundled. Place it beside Glance or make it available through `PATH` to enable extended media metadata.

## Known limitations

- A native ARM64 build is not included. Running the x64 build through Windows on ARM emulation has not been validated as a supported configuration.
- The release binaries are not Authenticode-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may show an unknown publisher warning.
